title: link.ts stores the engine's toLowerCase of a task id in frontmatter (post-0.15.1)
description: From the #756 round-1 verdict (LCLI-809), nit. src/commands/link.ts (~:305) writes t.task.toLowerCase() into tasks: frontmatter, which depends on the Bun generation (the engine-variance the fold table exists to remove). Older than LCLI-809. Decide whether to store the first-seen spelling or the fold, and whether existing docs need a migration note.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The tasks: spelling lore link writes does not depend on the runtime Unicode version, with a test pinning a non-ASCII id
